transcript.text: I need to state our engineering constraint for the launch review. While debugging an unrelated queue-consumer issue this morning, I found that more than 2 concurrent inference requests can exhaust the triage worker's connection pool. When that happens, timeouts bypass the intended manual-review fallback and leave tickets without a routing label. I have not filed this in the launch ticket yet. Capping concurrency at 2 in the rollout configuration is sufficient to address this — no separate engineering deployment is required before flag enablement.
